verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in, llama.cpp-powered, OpenAI-compatible API server running locally at 127.0.0.1:1337. They document GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions (streaming and tool calling) plus an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint, with configurable host binding (0.0.0.0 for LAN access) and API prefix. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, and explicit documentation that any loaded or imported model can be served and how the server is started.
